name: Psychonomic Lash
text:
Target an enemy model in range.

Make an attack roll against the target model. If the attack hits, after the attack is resolved your opponent must show you their hand of Cypher cards, if the target is damaged by this attack you may additionally randomly select one of your opponent’s cypher cards to discard.

This Fury causes force damage.
changes: Added "after the attack is resolved" timing. The attacking player can also discard a random card if they damaged an enemy model with this fury.
